name: Snoezelen Whimsical Forest
summary:
1. Pick up the falling star and place it in the center.
2. Look at the empty spot on the constellation board and place the appearing star in the correct position.
3. Hold the xylophone mallet and play the xylophone.
4. Push away the cosmic mist blocking your view with your hand.
5. Respond appropriately when an unexpected situation occurs.
